recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆分葉核嗜中性球，細胞核分成 3–4 葉、以細絲相連並圍成環狀排列，染色質粗塊，細胞質淡粉紅並散佈細小紫色顆粒，無空泡或杜勒小體，是正常成熟的嗜中性球。
features: Cell about 1.5–2 times the diameter of an RBC
Nucleus with 3–4 lobes connected by thin filaments, arranged in a loose circle
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine to slightly prominent purple granules
Adjacent red cells in a thicker area with a few platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a mature segmented neutrophil with a three- to four-lobed nucleus connected by thin chromatin filaments, coarse chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasm is pale pink with fine to slightly prominent granules, without Döhle bodies or vacuoles. Surrounding red cells overlap in a thicker area, and a few platelets are present. Findings represent normal mature neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are coarse and dark blue-black throughout the cytoplasm, usually with vacuoles or Döhle bodies, rather than fine purple granules.
A ring nucleus is a single continuous doughnut without separate lobes, whereas this nucleus is composed of distinct lobes joined by filaments.
Hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes (or many five-lobed cells), not the three to four seen here.
